hero.title:
Analyze data.
Transform ideas.
hero.sub: Zeta is a data analysis and transformation language with Rust/Python hybrid syntax, native C++20 engine, and renderers for dashboard and terminal.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Designed for data analysts, systems engineers, and DSL designers.
features.syntax_desc: Python familiarity with Rust robustness. Variables with $, collections with <>, and a dynamic type system with 15 value types.
features.engine_desc: High-performance interpreter with no GC. Complete pipeline: Lexer → Parser → AST → Interpreter.
features.dataframes_desc: Load CSV with load_csv, access columns with $data:sales, and transform data without external dependencies.
features.errors_desc: Error propagation with ?, is_error, is_null. Null behaves like NaN, not like an exception.
features.abi_desc: Load .so / .dll with a single load_lib(...). Automatic marshalling of Zeta vectors to C pointers.
features.renderers_desc: zeta_dashboard (OpenGL + ImGui), zeta_term (ANSI 24-bit), and an HTTP REST server with endpoints for data, metrics, and charts.
